item.title: E-commerce Operations Specialist

item.title: Email & Newsletter Marketing

item.title: Store Display & Merchandising

item.title: Digital Marketing Photography

item.title: Photoshoot and Studio Direction
item.description: Assisted in creative direction for fashion photoshoots by coordinating with hair and makeup artists, styling models, and supporting both studio and on-location photography production.

item.title: Fashion Design and Pattern Making
